title: PAG, SAG and TCFG: what the extra guidance costs

questions.q: How many predictions per step does cfg 7 with PAG cost?
questions.why: Positive, negative, and the positive with damaged attention.

questions.q: Why is SAG not cheap at cfg 1?
options: It runs at double the resolution
It calls the VAE each step
It forces the unconditional back on, then adds another prediction: three in all
questions.answer: It forces the unconditional back on, then adds another prediction: three in all
questions.why: It sets disable_cfg1_optimization, because it needs the unconditional's attention.

questions.q: What does TCFG add per step?
options: One SVD, and no extra prediction
questions.answer: One SVD, and no extra prediction
questions.why: It's a pre-cfg hook working on predictions the sampler already has.
